sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Syed Wajid Ali,Santosh Kumar Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- Govt. Advocate,Mohammad Waseem,R.P. Tiwari
Hon'ble Subhash Chandra Sharma,J.
Supplementary affidavit filed today by learned counsel for the applicants including certified copy of
verified compromise is taken on record.

Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned counsel for the opposite party as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the material on record.
It is submitted that in this case both the parties are entered into compromise and matter in dispute has been settled amicably and compromise has also been verified before the learned trial court regarding which report transmitted by the learned court is on record, therefore, request to quash the Wasim Akram And 3 Ors vs State Of U.P. And Another on 15 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/94966053/
1

entities.text: Wasim Akram And 3 Ors vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: entire proceedings of the case on the basis of compromise between the parties.
Learned counsel for the opposite party as well as learned A.G.A. has no objection in this regard.

On considering the facts and circumstances of the case, submissions made by learned counsel for both the parties as well as learned A.G.A. and the fact that dispute between the parties has been settled amicably and compromise entered into between the parties which has already been verified by the learned trial court copy of which is on record, therefore, it will be of no use to keep the proceedings pending before the learned court.
As a result, it will be in the interest of justice to quash the entire proceedings of the case in terms of compromise.

Accordingly, the entire proceedings including impugned charge-sheet dated 21.03.2014 in Criminal Case No. 3259 of 2014 (State Vs. Wasim & others) arising out of Case Crime No. 2304 of 2013,
under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471 I.P.C. at Police Station Kotwali, District Bareilly pending in the court of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Bareilly are hereby quashed in terms of compromise between the parties.
